system.description:
Your creations no longer lean on your presence to endure; you cast an illusion over a place and walk away, leaving it to persist behind you.

Once you have created any Chimerstry illusion, the expenditure of a single Blood Trait grants it Permanency. The phantasm then remains until you dissolve it or until someone sees through the illusion in some fashion, whether or not you stay in the area. Retest with Subterfuge.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
